policy.identity: Pass only when the label-hidden creature observation semantically identifies the mapped family and form; ambiguous neighboring-family reads fail.
policy.tier: Pass only when perceivedTier exactly equals the controller target tier.
policy.archetype: Pass only when the perceived combat role semantically communicates the mapped form's primary archetype or battlefield duty.
policy.decision: approved-review requires all eight receipt dimensions to pass; any failed dimension yields revise. Anatomy, affinity neutrality, counterplay, framing, and finish are translated directly from the blind verdict files.
